headline: HIGHLIGHT's Lee Gi-kwang to host Arirang TV's 'K-POPCON'
sub: New weekly K-pop live showcase premieres Dec 12
source: Source: Around Us Entertainment via Star Daily News, Topstar News
caption:
HIGHLIGHT's Lee Gi-kwang has been named the host of 'K-POPCON,' a new K-pop show on Arirang TV.

According to his agency Around Us, 'K-POPCON' is a live K-pop showcase where artists perform and chat in front of Korean and international audiences at Arirang Music Studio in Seoul, with a focus on artists from small and mid-sized agencies. The show premieres Dec 12 and airs every Saturday, with stages also uploaded to the ARIRANG K-POP YouTube channel. Gi-kwang holds his first recording on Nov 20.

📌 Source: Around Us Entertainment via Star Daily News, Topstar News (via Korean media)
